Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Saitama Prefecture is providing emergency subsidies to small and medium-sized enterprises in the prefecture to ease the impact of rising prices for processing rice and sake-brewing rice. The subsidy will cover part of the price increase for these rice types.

【Eligible applicants】
Small and medium-sized enterprises with their head office or main business location in Saitama Prefecture that manufacture alcoholic beverages (such as sake), condiments (such as miso), or confectionery (such as rice crackers) using processing rice and sake-brewing rice.

【Eligible products】
Only Reiwa 7 (2025) harvest processing rice (regular and glutinous rice) or sake-brewing rice (brown rice or milled rice) that:
• Were purchased for manufacturing alcoholic beverages, condiments, confectionery, etc. by an eligible applicant
• Were delivered and fully paid for by October 31, Reiwa 8 (2026)

【Contact】
Saitama Prefecture Processing Rice Emergency Price Support Subsidy Call Center
TEL 0120-964-048　9 a.m. to 5 p.m. (closed weekends and national holidays)

For details and flyers, visit the Saitama Prefecture website (link provided in the original announcement).

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2710/
